indoorStreetViewVerdict.google: NO. No indoor Street View and no indoor photosphere exists inside 부산역. 12/12 interior grid points (r=20 m, all 7 imagery types) returned 'Search returned no images.'; r=25 m at the concourse centroid also empty. Nearest imagery of any type is the user photosphere wKjqWFcrMTBad9zh8_Itgw, measured 74 m away in the forecourt. Outdoor coverage exists (jtAQJfAdxWn-bGymBrVBGw)
indoorStreetViewVerdict.naver: UNCONFIRMED, probably absent. Not provable here: allSearch is captcha-walled, instantSearch 404s, place summary returns a null stub, the headless browser was killed on map.naver.com, and my panorama nearby endpoint failed a Seoul Station control so it proves nothing. Documentary evidence points to absence: Naver's coverage release lists 인천국제공항/서울역/고속터미널 but not 부산역, and 실내뷰 panoramas cover only 일부 건축물
indoorStreetViewVerdict.kakao: INDOOR VECTOR MAP YES, PANORAMA NO. Kakao+KORAIL shipped 기차역 실내지도 for 54 stations incl. 부산역 on 2025-05-02; Kakao's search JSON gives indoor_info zoneid=181917, floor=2 for the 대합실 level. storeview_id=0, so there is no indoor panorama at this POI. Web surface confirmed dead by the floorplan lane: 192 captured requests on map.kakao.com returned no indoor tiles, and /inside/*, /indoor/*, /api/inside/* all serve the generic shell — the indoor map is app-only
indoorStreetViewVerdict.netEffect: No metrically-consistent indoor panorama source is available for 부산역. The interior must be driven by the official 2F 안내도 floor-guide board (scaled to the confirmed shell bounds) with the video keyframes and head-on storefront stills supplying bay widths, ceiling structure and fixture positions
